QUARRY.//: V6 (carried 10-0 + Cam, 2026-10-18), 'Know your quarry': every creature you (or your pack, or your pets) beat is counted, and what you know of it fills in -- `tiers`: its weak weapon style at 10, what it resists at 50, its elements at 150. MASTERY (Cam's q1 b, the Mathematician's): about `hours` of hunting the ground it shows up most on, worked out per creature from how often it turns up and how long a fight there takes, rounded to `round`, between `min` and `max`. A mastered creature takes `bonus.dmg` more from you and drops `bonus.drops` more, and now and then (`dropChance`) drops its own special thing (MASTERY_DROPS) -- bound, never sold (the Economist).

MASTERY_DROPS.//: The Game Developer's first list (V6): the farmyard and the crypt. Every other creature's mastery gives the trophy and the +10% now; its own drop comes once Cam has read the rest of the list (collab N8). `does` is what the item sheet says; the effects are wired in core/40-zzz-zc (quarry*). Icons borrow another's picture (iconAs) until the Art Director's sheet is painted.

goldenfeather.name: Golden feather
goldenfeather.about: A chicken's mastery: for the patient. A plume for any hat, once the Art Director paints it -- for now, a trophy in your Bestiary.

emeraldfly.name: Emerald fly
emeraldfly.about: A duck's mastery, tied as a fly: in the bag, +5% speed at every fly-fishing spot.

luckytrotter.name: Lucky trotter
luckytrotter.about: A pig's mastery, a charm: in the bag, +2% rare finds when digging.

foxbrush.name: Fox's brush
foxbrush.about: A fox's mastery: a tail scarf, once the Art Director paints it -- for now, a trophy in your Bestiary.

ancientfemur.name: Ancient femur
ancientfemur.about: A skeleton's mastery: the crafting bench makes a Grand bone staff with it (+15% to the risen).

gravesalt.name: Grave salt
gravesalt.about: A ghoul's mastery: a Paladin blesses a blade with it like holy water, for twice as many hits.

echobell.name: Echo bell
echobell.about: A crypt bat's mastery: in the bag, the Hollow Crypt's night creatures come 10% more often (more wisps, more life essence).

wraithveil.name: Wraith's veil
wraithveil.about: A wraith's mastery: in the bag, the undead's first hit in each fight is halved.

wispjar.name: Wisp in a jar
wispjar.about: A wisp's mastery: a light for your house. Once a week, a vigil at the graves always meets a wisp.

grandbonestaff.name: Grand bone staff
grandbonestaff.about: A Necromancer's staff, made with an ancient femur: +15% to the risen.
